🇷🇺 Russia 'Satisfied' with Ukraine Security Guarantees - Kushner US envoy Jared Kushner stated that Washington has persuaded Moscow to consider security guarantees for Ukraine analogous to NATO's Article 5. While Russia remains sceptical, Kushner noted the importance of resuming dialogue between Europe and Russia. According to The Guardian, Donald Trump is open to providing such collective defence commitments, provided they align with US national interests and form part of a broader European security package. Kushner described this as a significant step. However, no official confirmation from Moscow exists regarding consent to these terms. Notably, discussions on reciprocal security guarantees for Russia remain absent. @Slavyangrad
